name: gurado WebConnect
author: gurado

sections.description:
gurado WebConnect lets you embed the gurado voucher/ticket widget on any page using a Gutenberg block or a shortcode.

Key features
🛍️ Direct shop integration: Seamlessly display your gurado gift card shop on your own website – no redirection needed.
⚡ Ready to use: Just install, enter your shop ID, and start selling – no coding required.
💳 Multiple payment methods: Supports all payment options provided by gurado.
🔒 Secure and reliable: Works through gurado’s verified and trusted interfaces.
🧩 Flexible embedding: Available as a Gutenberg block or via the [gurado_widget] shortcode.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. In the editor, insert the block “gurado WebConnect”.
  3. Fill shop (required) and optional attributes.
  4. For Classic Editor use the shortcode:
    [gurado_widget shop=”my-shop” mode=”bubble” page=”” align=”right” offsetX=”1rem” offsetY=”8px”]
sections.faq:
The widget does not render

Ensure shop is set and the vendor script is reachable over HTTPS.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Initial public release with block + shortcode and i18n support.
